structs.name: bot_data_t
structs.size_evidence: NOT PROVEN. Lower bound 32696: highest direct bot-pointer access (Bot_SetBotPersistentMatchData@0x141346bd0 writes +32688 as a 4-byte float). Bot_ResetBotInfo@0x1413462e0 also reaches +32692 (dword index 8173). SV_BotInit@0x141359d50 stores bot+16 = a1+34064 = bot+32696, and Bot_ResetBotInfo clears a 0x4400 (17408) byte block through bot[2] at that address, which suggests the bot region reaches at least 50104 if the block is embedded. Upper bound: bot_data_t sits in SvClientMP at +1368 inside _pad558 (178184 bytes) and sendAsActive follows at +179552, so 178184 if the bot is the last member before it. Game-test 131056 is not contradicted, and neither is IDA 261536, but nothing here proves either.

structs.notes: The current IDA members at +0 and +4 are wrong for Replay (one 8-byte pointer, not header + pad), and bIsScriptedAgent is at +32692, not +32860. The bot data is embedded in SvClientMP at +1368 (SV_BotInit), so the coordinator should check the client's _pad558 (SvClientMP, 178184 bytes at +1368) against any proposed bot size before resizing either struct. Bot_ResetBotInfo clears [0,29272) only, so the persistent part starts at 29272 (the difficulty flag Bot_SetBotPersistentMatchData writes at +29272).
